d:
The auction for Chandiramani’s flat turns chaotic when Popatlal jokingly bids ₹60 lakh just to show off. When pressed to deposit the token money, he backs out, getting scolded by everyone before the auction restarts from ₹56.5 lakh.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
